# Check Point Software
> Check Point Software provides enterprise and government cyber security solutions across network, cloud, workspace, SASE, and security operations.

Check Point offers product documentation, API and management references, deployment guides, training resources, and product-specific solution pages spanning Quantum, CloudGuard, Harmony, Infinity, and SASE platforms.

## Core Platform
- [Hybrid Mesh Network Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/hybrid-mesh-network-security/): Overview of Check Point’s distributed network security architecture across on-premises, cloud, and edge.
- [Infinity Platform](https://www.checkpoint.com/infinity-platform/): Unified cyber security platform covering prevention, management, and shared intelligence across environments.
- [Infinity AI Copilot](https://www.checkpoint.com/ai/): AI-focused security capabilities and platform initiatives across Check Point products.
- [Security Management](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/unified-management/): Centralized policy, operations, and visibility for Check Point security environments.
- [Support Center](https://support.checkpoint.com/): Product support portal for knowledge articles, downloads, cases, and lifecycle resources.
- [CheckMates Community](https://community.checkpoint.com/): Technical community with discussions, best practices, announcements, and peer support.

## Network Security
- [Quantum Network Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/): Network security portfolio for data centers, branches, remote users, and high-performance environments.
- [Next-generation Firewalls](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/next-generation-firewall/): Enterprise firewall platform with threat prevention, segmentation, and application control.
- [SMB Firewalls](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/next-generation-firewall/small-business-firewall/): Security appliances designed for small and medium-sized business deployments.
- [Industrial Firewalls](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/next-generation-firewall/industrial-control-systems-appliances/): Ruggedized appliances for industrial control systems and operational technology environments.
- [SD-WAN](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/sd-wan/): Secure SD-WAN capabilities for branch connectivity, performance, and policy enforcement.
- [Remote Access VPN](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/remote-access-vpn/): Secure remote connectivity for users accessing corporate applications and networks.
- [Maestro Hyperscale Network Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/maestro-hyperscale-network-security/): Scalable firewall clustering and orchestration for high-throughput security deployments.
- [DDoS Protector](https://www.checkpoint.com/quantum/ddos-protector/): DDoS mitigation for volumetric, protocol, and application-layer attacks.

## Cloud Security
- [CloudGuard](https://www.checkpoint.com/cloudguard/): Cloud-native security platform for posture management, workload protection, and application security.
- [Cloud Network Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/cloudguard/cloud-network-security/): Cloud firewalls and segmentation for public cloud network protection.
- [Cloud Web Application and API Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/cloudguard/appsec/): WAAP capabilities for web applications, APIs, bot protection, and runtime defense.
- [Microsoft Azure Security WAN](https://www.checkpoint.com/cloudguard/microsoft-azure-security/wan/): Secure virtual WAN integration for Azure networking and cloud connectivity.
- [AI Cloud Protect](https://www.checkpoint.com/ai/cloudprotect/): Security controls for AI factories, AI workloads, and cloud-based AI infrastructure.
- [Cloud Security Posture Management](https://www.checkpoint.com/cloudguard/cloud-security-posture-management/): Posture management for cloud assets, configurations, and compliance monitoring.
- [Cloud Workload Protection](https://www.checkpoint.com/cloudguard/cloud-workload-protection/): Protection for workloads, containers, hosts, and runtime environments in cloud deployments.

## SASE and Zero Trust
- [Check Point SASE](https://sase.checkpoint.com/): Secure access service edge platform for users, branches, and internet access.
- [Private Access](https://sase.checkpoint.com/private-access): Zero trust network access for private applications and internal resources.
- [Internet Access](https://sase.checkpoint.com/internet-access): Secure web and SaaS access with policy enforcement and threat prevention.
- [ZTNA](https://www.checkpoint.com/harmony/secure-access-service-edge/zero-trust-network-access/): Zero trust access capabilities for identity-aware application connectivity.
- [Secure Web Gateway](https://www.checkpoint.com/harmony/secure-access-service-edge/secure-web-gateway/): Web security controls for browsing, SaaS usage, and internet-bound traffic.
- [CASB](https://www.checkpoint.com/harmony/secure-access-service-edge/casb/): Cloud access security broker capabilities for SaaS visibility and control.

## Workspace and User Security
- [Harmony](https://www.checkpoint.com/harmony/): User and workspace security for endpoints, email, collaboration, and access.
- [Endpoint Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/harmony/endpoint/): Endpoint protection, EDR/XDR, anti-ransomware, and device security capabilities.
- [Email and Collaboration Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/harmony/email-collaboration/): Protection for email, phishing, account takeover, and collaboration platforms.
- [Mobile Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/harmony/mobile/): Mobile threat defense for enterprise devices, apps, and network connections.
- [Browse Security](https://www.checkpoint.com/harmony/browse/): Browser-based protection against phishing, malicious downloads, and web threats.
- [Data Loss Prevention](https://www.checkpoint.com/harmony/data-loss-prevention/): DLP controls for sensitive data across endpoints, email, and collaboration tools.

## Security Operations and Threat Prevention
- [Threat Prevention](https://www.checkpoint.com/threat-prevention/): Overview of Check Point’s prevention-first approach to stopping advanced cyber threats.
- [ThreatCloud AI](https://www.checkpoint.com/threatcloud-ai/): Threat intelligence and AI-driven prevention powering Check Point protections.
- [Managed Detection and Response](https://www.checkpoint.com/managed-detection-and-response/): Managed security monitoring, investigation, and response services.
- [Incident Response](https://www.checkpoint.com/incident-response/): Professional services for breach response, containment, and recovery support.
- [Security Operations](https://www.checkpoint.com/cyber-security/security-operations/): Security operations capabilities spanning visibility, detection, and response workflows.
- [Research and Threat Intelligence](https://research.checkpoint.com/): Threat research, malware analysis, campaign reporting, and security intelligence updates.

## Documentation and Technical Resources
- [Check Point Documentation Portal](https://sc1.checkpoint.com/documents/latest/APIs/index.html): Central technical documentation and API entry point for Check Point products.
- [API Reference Index](https://sc1.checkpoint.com/documents/latest/APIs/index.html#introduction~v1.0%20): API documentation for management, orchestration, and product integrations.
- [Management API Introduction](https://sc1.checkpoint.com/documents/latest/APIs/index.html#web/introduction): Introduction to Check Point web APIs and management automation concepts.
- [CLI Reference](https://sc1.checkpoint.com/documents/latest/CLI/EN/Content/Topics-CLI/Introduction.htm): Command-line reference for administration and operational tasks.
- [R81 Security Management Administration Guide](https://sc1.checkpoint.com/documents/R81/WebAdminGuides/EN/CP_R81_SecurityManagement_AdminGuide/Topics-SECMG/Introduction.htm): Administration guide for Check Point security management deployments.
- [R81 Gaia Administration Guide](https://sc1.checkpoint.com/documents/R81/WebAdminGuides/EN/CP_R81_Gaia_AdminGuide/Topics-GAG/Introduction.htm): Operating system administration guide for Gaia-based appliances and gateways.
- [R81 Installation and Upgrade Guide](https://sc1.checkpoint.com/documents/R81/WebAdminGuides/EN/CP_R81_Installation_and_Upgrade_Guide/Topics-IUG/Introduction.htm): Installation, migration, and upgrade procedures for Check Point environments.
- [SK Knowledge Base](https://support.checkpoint.com/results/sk/sk0): Search entry for support knowledge articles and technical solutions.
